judged.what: Fega predicts he will end the match 7-2, but right after scoring to make it 6-2, his opponent quits, making him burst out laughing: 'He left!'
judged.reason: Fega confidently predicts a 7-2 scoreline, but immediately after scoring to reach six goals, the opponent rage-quits, causing a genuinely funny moment and big laughter.
